name: M107
description:
The M82A1 is one of the most prolific anti-materiel rifles ever produced. It is semi-automatic and magazine-fed, allowing it to put out rounds incredibly quickly for the caliber. The A1M variant includes numerous upgrades to the muzzle brake, a rear grip with a monopod socket, and improved accessory rails.

Extremely high damage with a high rate of fire, but cumbersome handling and recoil that is ill-suited for that firerate.

Big whoop, I'm using a Barrett .50 cal. I could kill a building.

Model submitted by Rialag
